maya: Heads-up: after last night's oob BMC firmware push in ap-south1 we're seeing intermittent host reboots and sensor read failures on the GPU racks.
maya: Observed ~6 hosts with out-of-band disconnects and 3 nodes auto-rebooted in the past 12m.
infra-bot: [ALERT] oob-bmc-sensor-failure - 6 hosts - severity: high - link: https://infra.alerts/29123 :bangbang:
sam: Which image did we push? Can we pause the rollout for remaining racks? @devon
maya: fw v2.6.4 -> v2.7.0, rollout window 03:00-05:00. Canary was ap-south1-canary (no issues there). Noticed the BMC temps spike and then `sensor: present->absent` followed by IPMI session drop.
leo: Pasted IPMI logs from one affected host:
```
[ 12:31:03 ] ipmi: sensor_read fail: code=0x45
[ 12:31:05 ] oob: nic-link lost
[ 12:31:07 ] host: watchdog-triggered-reboot
```
anita: GPU scheduler: allocation dropped 18% in ap-south1. Autoscaler tried to reschedule into uwo2 and us-east-2 -> incurred burst capacity and cross-region egress costs.
devon: +1 pause rollout. Suggest rollback to v2.6.4 on affected BMCs only, and add a temporary routing policy to prefer local spare racks instead of cross-region fallback.
ops-oncall: Kicking off targeted rollback now. Running:
```
./provisioner rollback-bmc --hosts host-403,host-407,host-412 --image v2.6.4 --force
```
ops-oncall: ETA ~9m, will update when complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: Can someone post the runbook and the ticket so SRE oncall can follow? :eyes:
maya: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oob-bmc-rollback
maya: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-5123
infra-bot: Change detected: rollback job started by ops-oncall (job id rjob-8821)
devon: Also please lock secure-boot flag on canaries to ensure we don't flip it inadvertently during images change.
ops-oncall: Rollback finished on 3 hosts, BMCs back online, sensors stable on those. Monitoring: temp and ipmi sessions look normal so far.
anita: GPU capacity restored ~12% after rollback, autoscaler canceled cross-region allocation. Cost spike estimated at ~$120 for the 2h fallback.
maya: We'll hold the remainder of the rollout. Follow-up: re-run regression tests against v2.7.0 in staging and open a bug for the sensor driver. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
